findings.title: Material-title whitelist silently drops legitimate material links
evidence:
probe class-download-anchor-FN: '
2026 Interim ReportDownload
' -> patched candidates=[], coverage_status=checked_index_only, limitations=[]; base 0d7ada21 -> 1 candidate https://ir.example/ir2026.pdf
probe class-aria-label-icon-FN: '' -> patched []; base 1 candidate (empty title)
probe class-annual-results-FN: '2025 Annual Results' + 'Interim Results 2026' + 'Q3 2026 Financial Results' -> patched []; base 3 candidates
probe class-cn-phone-call-FN: '2026年半年度电话会纪要' -> patched []; base 1 candidate; '电话会' is in _TRANSCRIPT_TITLE_TOKENS but not _MATERIAL_TITLE_TOKENS while 'transcript' is in both
probe class-corporate-deck-FN: 'Corporate Deck 2026' -> patched []; base 1 candidate
probe coverage-all-filtered-static: '2025 Annual Results' + 'Board Deck' -> checked_index_only, limitations=[], no_documents_claimed=false (no signal that anchors were rejected)
commands: python -X utf8 -B tmp/review/w11_probe.py, python -X utf8 -B tmp/review/extra_probe.py
findings.expected: Business-material leads remain candidates; anchor text is not the only lead source; if links are rejected, coverage does not silently look clean.
findings.actual: Deterministic silent loss for Download/aria-label/Annual Results/Corporate Deck/CN transcript markup; checked_index_only with no limitation.
findings.required_fix: Derive the lead from anchor text + aria-label/title/alt + nearest item-container text (tr/li/article) or a URL-basename token under a strict legal veto; add an explicit ignored/title_unmatched limitation or count for rejected anchors; add regression tests for the five inputs; re-run and re-review.
